annotations.text:
The card that renders under every property the agent mentions.

Two problems with different fixes. Visual: the card is the search-results list row, borderless because that list has dividers — in a grey bubble it reads as another paragraph. Content: the prompt tells the model to bold the address before emitting the token, so the address, the status and the proposal are each said twice.

Read left to right. Each option moves the same line — how much identity the card carries versus the prose.

Drawn at the real surface: the Ask view is now a full page with a 720px column, so the bubble is 680px wide here. The first draft assumed the old 420px drawer — that is where the earlier narrow cards came from.

All three give the card a surface it does not have today: white fill against the grey bubble, plus a border. Today it has neither at rest, only a hover, which says nothing on touch.

Chosen. The address stays, in the quiet line beside the council and the date — enough to tell which paragraph a card belongs to when an answer cites several properties, without becoming a second headline.

Checked at 720px: the longest meta line tried (Ardilaun, Malahide Road, Swords, Co. Dublin · Fingal · Jan 2026) fits with room to spare, and truncates rather than wraps if a longer one turns up.
